layoutPrompt: Turn this image into one photorealistic live-action film frame, {width} by {height} pixels. It is a 3D layout of the frame: keep its framing and camera exactly, and where each person stands, how large they are, their pose and the way they face. It shows only shapes: draw real people, clothes and surroundings in their place, in natural color. Each person and thing in it is tinted a color; how each one looks follows.
